reason: I already learn Thai dishes for free from YouTube and blogs, and three free dishes a month is more than I'd actually cook from a new app. Even at $2.99 I don't pay for recipes, and talking out loud to my phone with greasy hands while the wok's going feels silly.
objection: Talking to an app while I cook feels awkward, and I can't see what it gives me that a good free Thai cooking video doesn't, especially from a brand-new app with zero reviews.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free dishes it clearly beat my YouTube routine, say the substitutes for ingredients I can't get here actually worked and tasted like what I ate in Thailand, I might pay for a month.
